draftBody:
Hi all,

Thanks for today. Quick recap so we're aligned:

Decisions
• Let's go with the background job for Q3.
• Cap at fifteen hundred rows with an error this week, background job lands in Q3.

Action items
• You: I'll write the postmortem and send it to Marcus by Wednesday. (by Wed 23 Sept)
• Marcus Chen: I'll notify Northwind about the workaround today. (by Sun 20 Sept)
• Dana Kowalski: I'll add the background export to the Q3 roadmap doc so we can size it Thursday. (by Thu 24 Sept)
• Tomás Herrera: I can ship a quick fix that caps exports at fifteen hundred rows with a clear error by Friday. (by Fri 25 Sept)

Shout if I missed or misread anything.

Best,
You
